status: fixed_and_locally_verified; final bank and native qualification remain root-owned
cause: The note>31 branch suddenly enabled coupled-course detuning and consumed six additional random draws, reshuffling audible course phases and the following contact texture.
The note<48 branch suddenly changed coupled-course weight from0.28 to0.36.

Engine passes fractional sounding-register pitch, including fine tuning/Scala/MTS. These contours are not independent physical-key course counts, so the two steps changed onset timbre under tiny tuning changes.

fix.coupled_detuning: Cubic smoothstep from zero to the existing full detuning across MIDI30..32.
fix.coupled_weight: Cubic smoothstep from0.28 to0.36 across MIDI47..49.
fix.random_sequence: Reserve a detune draw for each of the six coupled modes even when its detuning blend iszero, so mode phases and contact random state are independent of the register branch.
fix.cost: Only piano note-on; six extra random advances for previously undetuned bass, two smoothstep evaluations, no new state, allocations, parameters, mode choices, or audio-rate work.
fix.outside_transition: Other models are untouched. Piano detuned registers outside47..49 retain exactly their worker34 samples; bass below32 may change because its previously shorter random stream is stabilized.

matched_focused_probe.condition: Hold playback frequency at the boundary, use identical seed, velocity0.95, brightness1, decay1; capture0.6s; compare RMS-matched samples from0.02..0.58s.
matched_focused_probe.interpretation: The old difference does not converge as onset pitches approach the boundary. The corrected difference passes unchanged residual and convergence gates. No acoustic identity or listening-quality score is inferred.

negative_control.description: Compile the same final2077-check test file against the exact pre-worker37 header. Only36 new continuity/convergence assertions fail.

fixture.modulation: Pressure0 to0.8 at1024; frequency raised one semitone at2048.

preservation_probe.expected_exact: Every non-piano model and piano36/60/96; bass piano24 deliberately changes with stabilized random-sequence consumption.
